heading: Establishment of best practices for evidence retention

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Director of the National Institute of Justice, in consultation with Federal, State, and local law enforcement agencies and government laboratories, shall—

children.text: establish best practices for evidence retention to focus on the preservation of forensic evidence; and
assist State, local, and tribal governments in adopting and implementing the best practices established under paragraph (1).

tree.heading: Deadline
tree.text: Not later than 1 year after December 16, 2016, the Director of the National Institute of Justice shall publish the best practices established under subsection (a)(1).

tree.heading: Limitation
tree.text: Nothing in this section shall be construed to require or obligate compliance with the best practices established under subsection (a)(1).

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 14136f of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
